final_message:
I cleaned the data by removing duplicate order events (keeping the first occurrence), normalizing category names (trimming spaces and converting to lowercase), and converting total values to numbers (handling strings with commas). Orders with missing totals (-1) were excluded from revenue calculations. I converted all placed_at timestamps to UTC to determine the month correctly.
